description: Reads the Desk's published research about players in general, word for word. Each piece comes with its question, headline, answers and figures, the group of past players it counts and the day it was measured. Call it when someone asks about players or teams in general, such as how often players move up or back down, or home advantage. Never call it for one named player, team or match, because every figure is a rate over a group. Pass `about`, a few words on the question, or `pieces` for a piece you know. It needs no Desk Pass.

about.description: A few words on the question, for example 'how players do after a bump, and how many move back down'.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

pieces.description: One or two pieces, each named by its address after /research/, as https://thetennisdesk.com/research lists them. Optional.

name: read_research
title: The Desk's research figures
